answer: Assembling that for 177 aliases means 177 times 6 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. Because each jade escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the opal ledger records every share and the vine audit publishes the split. A bond must be split across 6 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. That is 20 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
